title: OutcomeEvent
description: The measured result of a decision over an evaluation window, plus the counterfactual basis. ONE schema serves all three attribution methods: the `method` field says which counterfactual field is authoritative, and validation requires the fields that method needs. Emitted once the window closes -- this is the turn that makes the map smarter.

method.description: The counterfactual basis actually available for THIS outcome. Sets which fields below are authoritative and the trust tier of the resulting lift.

observed_value.description: The realized (treated) value in the window.

control_value.description: REQUIRED when method='holdout'. The control-arm value over the same window.

baseline_value.description: REQUIRED when method='pre_post'. The pre-period (or comparison) value.

comparison_delta.description: Optional for method='pre_post'. A comparison group's own pre->post change, subtracted to make it difference-in-differences instead of naive pre/post.

counterfactual_value.description: REQUIRED when method='observational'. The modeled counterfactual (matched cohort / synthetic control), computed upstream since matching is not warehouse-native.

n_treatment.description: Sample size behind observed_value; enables confidence intervals.

n_control.description: Sample size behind the counterfactual/control; enables confidence intervals.
